top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a specific conceptual step, magic-wavelength trapping that cancels the light shift so many atoms are interrogated at once, validated by independent reproduction at the 1e-18 level over two decades. The two-name allocation (Katori, Ye) is the one every proposer converged on, so it is easier to defend than the three-seat cut forced in P002. P002 is the more exciting new-phenomenon story but is only about eight years old, with the mechanism unsettled and Cao and earlier band-structure theorists outside the credited three. Both are preferable to no award.
